children: SCG Chemicals has diversified its naphtha sourcing to import from other regions to cope with the delivery disruptions from the Strait of Hormuz, the company's CEO said on Thursday.
The company has been buying mostly from India, Australia and Nigeria, SCG Chemicals CEO Sakchai Patiparnpreechavud said on the sidelines of the APPEC conference.
Some volumes from the United Arab Emirates have been delivered via ship-to-ship transfers, Patiparnpreechavud added.
SCG operates two naphtha crackers in Thailand with a total production capacity of 1.8 million metric tons a year.
